copy.heading: Early warning signs this week

items: Checked the forecast more than twice a day.
Watched golf on the telly for more than two hours.
Practised a swing with a household object.
Bought something golf-related "that was on offer".
Gone quiet during a conversation, and then said a word such as "birdie".

copy.instructions: Tick any sign you have shown. Two or more means Sue will speak to you.
